name: jwks-lint
description: Lint a JWKS document's contents against RFC 7517/7518/8037/8812 — leaked private keys, weak RSA moduli, kid collisions, alg/kty mismatches, x5c inconsistencies.
author: kofiadeyemiq

scripts.build: rm -rf dist && tsc -p tsconfig.build.json && chmod +x dist/cli.js
scripts.prepublishOnly: npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run build && npm run test:dist
